method_notes: Raw audit labels remain unchanged; this artifact projects them into evidence-navigation themes and is not a skill taxonomy.
Two independent non-overlapping corpus reviews supplied exact raw-label mappings; overlapping labels and later semantic red-team corrections were reconciled against audit workflows.
Close synonyms share a base target and genuine compounds map to at most three targets; optional article-scoped overrides disambiguate recurrent homonyms without changing raw audit labels.
Launch safety, survival state, evidence latency, investor truth, user acquisition versus company acquisition, urgency, stage, product type, and historical context remain distinct.
Canonical themes support later evidence retrieval only and must not be treated as final skill names or runtime instructions.
